title: Utsidan
description: A relaxed vanilla+ modpack, intended for forever-worlds.
body:
Utsidan is a modpack that's designed for long-term maps, or "forever worlds" as we call them these days. The modpack enhances the vanilla Minecraft experience, without overwhelming progression systems, excessive automation, or complex tech trees.

**Out goal is simple:** Build things, explore the world, and have fun! Hopefully in a stable world that will lasts for years to come. ;)

## What this modpack adds

### 🌿 Vanilla+ Gameplay Enhancements

- Quality-of-life improvements (like inventory sorting, crafting tweaks, better UI feedback)
- Clearer enchantment descriptions and advancement tracking
- Gravestones to prevent item loss
- Craftable name tags and small recipe improvements
- Balanced progression without grind-heavy mechanics

### 🏡 Building & Decoration

- Decorative blocks and rechiseled variants
- Hearth & Home building additions
- Furniture and cozy interior options
- Expanded storage options (Iron Chests, Tom’s Storage, Storage Delight)
- Litematica support for planned builds

### 🌍 Exploration & World Immersion

Exploration is enhanced, not overloaded.

- New structures for exploration
- Nature’s Compass for biome searching
- Antique Atlas for shared mapping
- Climate & river improvements
- Waystones for light fast-travel (server-friendly)

### 🍲 Food & Farming Expansion

Progress and build fully without relying on animal exploitation, while remaining balanced and optional.

- Vegan recipes for food (and vegan alternatives to animal products (e.g., leather)!
- Farmer’s Delight and compatible expansions
- Herbal brews and rustic cooking options
- Expanded food diversity without becoming a farming simulaton
  
### ⚡ Light Magic (Optional Progression)

Magic exists, but it doesn’t dominate the pack.

- Botania provides a magic-based progression path
- Enchanting Infuser for streamlined enchanting
- 
### 🚀 Performance & Stability

This pack is built to stay stable in a world meant to last.

- Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore, EntityCulling, Iris
- Server sleep support
- Optimized for long-term server performance

### 🎙️ Multiplayer Friendly

- Proximity voice chat
- Simple mentions
- No chat reporting
- Shared exploration tools

---

## Who is this for?

- Players who prefer building over automation
- Small friend servers
- Long-term survival worlds
- People who want a vanilla+ experience with fun quality-of-lite add-ons
